identification: Two small framed oil paintings attributed to Nan Gregory: (1) portrait of a dark-haired child in a white fur-trimmed parka, signed lower right (reads like 'NAN GREGORY'), gilt frame, about 30 x 25 cm; (2) misty gum-tree landscape with a dark figure leaning on the trunk, signed lower right, pale timber frame, largest 39 x 29 cm. No auction record found for a painter of this name; looks like a modest decorative amateur or mid-century hobbyist. Estimate 20-30, current bid $10.
